Formed in 2005 from the merger of Fiat Engineering and Tecnimont, it is publicly traded on the [[Milan Stock Exchange]]. Headquartered in Milan, the company provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services and technology solutions for the energy, chemicals, and industrial sectors. It operates globally through subsidiaries including Tecnimont, NextChem, and Stamicarbon. ==History== ===Origins=== Maire Tecnimont has its origins dating back to the 1930s with the founding of "Servizio Costruzioni e Impianti Fiat S.A.".{{cite web|url=https://www.mairetecnimont.com/it/gruppo/storia|title=Storia|access-date=22 April 2020|language=Italian|archive-date=13 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200113144940/https://www.mairetecnimont.com/it/gruppo/storia|url-status=dead}}{{cite book | author1=M. Colomba |title= I progetti Fiat Engineering (1937–1979), Volume 1| date=2011 | publisher=Silvana Editore|language= Italian}} It was set up as a division of the [[Fiat Group]] to design and construct equipment for car manufacturing. It was involved in the production of cogeneration and combined cycle plants both in Italy and abroad, also focusing on the Middle East and Latin America.{{citation needed|date=February 2026}} Servizio Costruzioni e Impianti Fiat S.A. was spun off from Fiat in 1972 under the name Fiat Engineering S.p.A.Maire Tecnimont, Strong fundamentals, low rating, Initiate with a 1-Overweight recommendation, Lehman Brothers, 11 January 2008 In 1966, [[Montecatini (company)|Montecatini]] and [[Edison (company)|Edison]] merged to form Montedison. In 1973, Montedison its consolidated engineering and development into a new subsidiary called Tecnimont S.p.A."{{cite news |title=Tecnimont: A turn of the key |newspaper=MEED |date=June 12, 2004 |url=https://www.meed.com/tecnimont-a-turn-of-the-key/ |accessdate=}} In 2004 Maire Holding acquired Fiat Engineering{{cite web |url=https://www.ilsole24ore.com/art/il-gruppo-maire-tecnimont-predispone-archivio-progetti-e-fotografie-26-milioni--AEmPCLGH|title=Il gruppo Maire Tecnimont predispone un archivio di progetti e fotografie da 26 milioni|date=16 January 2019 |access-date=18 July 2019|language=Italian}} and in 2005 acquired Tecnimont, forming Maire Tecnimont.{{cite web |url=https://ricerca.repubblica.it/repubblica/archivio/repubblica/2010/06/15/di-amato-dalla-chimica-agli-elicotteri.html|title=Di Amato, dalla chimica agli elicotteri|date=15 June 2010 |access-date=18 July 2019|language=Italian}} In 2007, Maire Tecnimont went public on the [[Milan Stock Exchange]].{{cite web |url=https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/maire-tecnimont-volano-ricavi-e-utili-e-il-titolo-vola-201803151749225448|title=Maire Tecnimont, volano ricavi e utili. E il titolo vola|date=15 March 2018 |access-date=18 July 2019|language=Italian}} === 2008 to present === In 2008 Maire Tecnimont finalised the acquisition of the entire share capital of [[:it:Tecnimont]] ICB Pvt. Ltd.{{cite web |url= https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/company/2331946Z:IN|title=Bloomberg – Tecnimont|website=[[Bloomberg News]]|language=English|access-date= 4 June 2020}} Also in 2008, the Group acquired Noy Engineering which expanded its technological portfolio.{{cite web|url= https://www.finanza.com/Finanza/Notizie_Italia/Italia/notizia/Maire_Tecnimont_acquisita_Noy_Engineering_per_23_mln-232511|title= Maire Tecnimont, acquisita Noy Engineering per 2,3 mln|language= Italian|access-date= 4 June 2020|archive-date= 14 January 2020|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20200114142026/https://www.finanza.com/Finanza/Notizie_Italia/Italia/notizia/Maire_Tecnimont_acquisita_Noy_Engineering_per_23_mln-232511|url-status= dead}} In 2009 Maire Tecnimont's acquisition of [[Stamicarbon]] allowed it to combine its traditional [[Engineering, procurement, and construction|EPC]] activities with technology licensing services.{{cite web |url= https://it.reuters.com/article/italianNews/idITLT40188720090729|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20200114142027/https://it.reuters.com/article/italianNews/idITLT40188720090729|url-status= dead|archive-date= 14 January 2020|title=Maire Tecnimont acquista Stamicarbon da olandese Dsm per 38 mln|language=Italian|access-date= 4 June 2020}} Also in 2009, it entered the renewable energy industry with the creation of Met NewEn. The new company operates in the [[biomass]] and concentrated [[solar power]] sector.{{cite web |url= https://st.ilsole24ore.com/art/impresa-e-territori/2016-02-12/maire-tecnimont-diventa-rinnovabile-063600.shtml?uuid=AC1CMtSC|title=Maire Tecnimont diventa rinnovabile|language=Italian|access-date= 4 June 2020}}{{cite web |url= http://www.alternativasostenibile.it/articolo/costruita-la-centrale-a-biomassa-olevano-lomellina-0210.html|title=Costruita la centrale a biomassa Olevano Lomellina!|date=January 2013 |language=Italian|access-date= 4 June 2020}} On 2 August 2010, the company signed a lease contract for two [[Garibaldi Towers]] in Milan.{{cite web |url=https://www.panorama.it/news/cronaca/come-sta-cambiando-lo-skyline-di-milano/|title=Come sta cambiando lo skyline di Milano|access-date=18 July 2019|language=Italian}}{{cite web |url=https://milano.fanpage.it/grattacieli-di-milano-torri-e-palazzi/|title=Grattacieli di Milano: torri e palazzi di una città in crescita|date=28 October 2016 |access-date=18 July 2019|language=Italian}} The same year, it acquired [[Technip |Technip KTI SpA (TKTI)]] through the acquisition of a parent company: Sofipart Srl.{{cite web |url= https://www.wallstreetitalia.com/maire-tecnimont-entra-nel-capitale-sociale-di-sofipart/|title=Maire Tecnimont entra nel capitale sociale di Sofipart|date=5 March 2010 |language=Italian|access-date= 4 June 2020}} In the first half of 2011, Maire Tecnimont created a new company named Tecnimont Civil Construction (TCC). The objective is to synergistically boost the Maire Tecnimont's expertise in the infrastructure and civil engineering sectors.{{cite web |url= https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/company/MT:IM?in_source=PersonProfile|title=Bloomberg – Maire Tecnimont SpA|website=[[Bloomberg News]]|language=English|access-date= 4 June 2020}} Starting in 2014–15, Tecnimont was part of a consortium along with [[Odebrecht]] and Estrella to develop the Punta Catalina coal-fired power plant in the [[Dominican Republic]]. Tecnimont was responsible for engineering and construction works, with the initial contract value estimated at US$1.9 billion.{{Cite web |title=Punta Catalina audit gets nasty |url=https://dr1.com/news/2025/09/08/punta-catalina-audit-gets-nasty/ |access-date=2026-01-06 |website=DR1.com |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=B&W Awarded Contract For Dominican Republic Coal Fired Boiler Project |url=https://www.babcock.com/home/about/corporate/news/bw-awarded-contract-for-dominican-republic-coal-fired-boiler-project |access-date=2026-01-06 |website=Babcock & Wilcox |language=en-US}} Following disputes over cost increases, the contractor consortium demanded additional funding to complete the project which was agreed to by the Dominican government. After the settlement, the plant was completed and commissioned.{{Cite web |date=2020-03-17 |title=The Dominican Government and the Odebrecht-Tecnimont-Estrella Consortium Reach Agreement to Settle All Existing Disputes and Guarantee Completion and Final Delivery of the Coal-Fired Central Termoeléctrica Punta Catalina Project (CTPC) |url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20200317005791/en/The-Dominican-Government-and-the-Odebrecht-Tecnimont-Estrella-Consortium-Reach-Agreement-to-Settle-All-Existing-Disputes-and-Guarantee-Completion-and-Final-Delivery-of-the-Coal-Fired-Central-Termoelctrica-Punta-Catalina-Project-CTPC |website=Business Wire}} In 2015, Maire Tecnimont, through its subsidiary Tecnimont and KT-Kinetics Technology, served served as an EPC contractor for key processing units of the SOCAR Polymer petrochemical complex located in the [[Sumgayit Chemical Industrial Park]] in [[Azerbaijan]].{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2019-02-19 |title=SOCAR Polymer commissions HDPE plant in Azerbaijan |url=https://www.ogj.com/refining-processing/refining/capacities/article/17279553/socar-polymer-commissions-hdpe-plant-in-azerbaijan |access-date=2026-01-06 |website=Oil & Gas Journal |language=en}} In 2016 Maire Tecnimont launched a new phase to bring about the digital transformation of its production processes{{cite web |url= https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/economia/2019/11/19/da-maire-tecnimont-50mln-su-innovazione_6c23c204-c08a-4865-a670-ad353cfaa9aa.html|title=Da Maire Tecnimont 50 mln su innovazione|date=19 November https://www.polimerica.it/articolo.asp?id=20916&from_rss=yes|title=Maire Tecnimont si lancia nella chimica verde|language=Italian|access-date= 4 June 2020}} In November, 2018 Maire Tecnimont set up [[Nextchem]], a new company to oversee [[green chemistry]] projects and projects focusing on energy transition. Among these, the construction of plants for the mechanical [[plastic recycling|recycling of plastic]], such as the one in [[Bedizzole]] (Brescia).{{cite web |url= https://www.rinnovabili.it/economia-circolare/nextchem-maire-tecnimont-riciclo-plastica/|title=Maire Tecnimont entra con Nextchem nel riciclo meccanico della plastica|date=21 February 2019 with a total value of approximately €1 billion.{{Cite web |title=Суд Лондона отказал "Еврохиму" в иске против банков о выплатах по гарантиям по заводу удобрений в Кингисеппе|url=https://rupec.ru/news/55626/|access-date=2026-01-06|website=rupec.ru|language=ru}} In 2022, Tecnimont suspended works, citing restrictions related to [[European Union sanctions]],{{Cite web |last=KC|first=Maya Lester|date=2025-12-18|title=EU General Court rejects Andrey and Aleksandra Melnichenko delisting applications|url=https://globalsanctions.com/2025/12/eu-general-court-rejects-andrey-and-aleksandra-melnichenko-delisting-applications/|access-date=2026-03-03|website=Global Sanctions|language=en-US}} while EuroChem subsequently terminated the contract, alleging non-fulfilment of contractual obligations. The dispute escalated into arbitration proceedings, followed by related litigation in multiple jurisdictions.{{Cite web |title=How Ukraine war brought a $2.2 bn-dollar dispute between Russian company & Italian firm to Bombay HC|url=https://theprint.in/judiciary/how-ukraine-war-brought-a-2-2-bn-dollar-dispute-between-russian-company-italian-firm-to-bombay-hc/2829111/|access-date=2026-03-03|website=theprint.in}}{{Cite web |title=Court orders EuroChem to halt overseas enforcement in defiance of ICC arbitration|url=https://iclg.com/news/23541-court-orders-eurochem-to-halt-overseas-enforcement-in-defiance-of-icc-arbitration|access-date=2026-03-03|website=International Comparative Legal Guides|language=en}} In December 2021, Maire Tecnimont subsidiary Tecnimont was awarded three of the five main EPC packages for the expansion project of the Borouge petrochemical complex located in the Ruwais industrial area, [[Abu Dhabi]], [[United Arab Emirates]].{{Cite web |title=BOROUGE 4 (B4) Project- Ethane Cracker |url=https://www.target.ae/projects/borouge-4-b4-project-ethane-cracker/ |access-date=2026-01-06 |website=www.target.ae}}{{Cite web |last=S |first=Mohammad |date=2022-02-12 |title=Groundbreaking Performed for $6.2bn Borouge 4 project |url=https://www.saudigulfprojects.com/2022/02/groundbreaking-performed-for-6-2bn-borouge-4-project/ |access-date=2026-01-06 |website=SaudiGulf Projects |language=en-US}} The packages awarded to Tecnimont include the construction of two new polyethylene units and a 1-hexene unit, utilities and offsites facilities, and a second cross-linkable polyethylene (XLPE) plant. The combined value of these three EPC packages is estimated at US$3.5 billion. In June 2023, Saudi Aramco and TotalEnergies awarded EPC contracts for the main processing units of the SATORP complex in the [[Jubail]] industrial area in [[Saudi Arabia]] to several international contractors. Maire Tecnimont was awarded two EPC contracts with a combined value of approximately US$2 billion, making it one of the key contractors involved in the development of the complex.{{Cite web extract: MAIRE (Maire Tecnimont S.p.A.) is an Italian engineering and contracting company. Formed in 2005 from the merger of Fiat Engineering and Tecnimont, it is publicly traded on the Milan Stock Exchange. Headquartered in Milan, the company provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services and technology solutions for the energy, chemicals, and industrial sectors. It operates globally through subsidiaries including Tecnimont, NextChem, and Stamicarbon.
